description: Lists the WhatsApp numbers connected to this workspace, one page at a time, each with its id, status and health at a glance. The number ids it returns are what other tools take as connection_id. Read-only.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

mode.description: Only numbers connected this way: coexistence or cloud_api.

status.description: Only numbers in this state, e.g. active.

name: list_numbers
title: List WhatsApp numbers
